question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.
The evening time when the sun has just set and it is almost dark.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Dusk"** refers to the time of day immediately following sunset. (संध्या)

 
 
• **Example:** The sky turned a beautiful shade of orange during dusk.
 
 
 
• **"Dawn"** refers to the first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise. (भोर)
 
 
• **Example:** The birds started chirping at the break of dawn.
 
 
 
• Hence, "Dusk" is the correct word for the evening time when the sun has just set and it is almost dark. (संध्या)
 
 
• **Example:** The streets were bustling with people returning home at dusk.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Night** (रात): The period of darkness in each twenty-four hours; the time from sunset to sunrise.

 
 
• **Example:** The stars were clearly visible in the night sky.
 
 
 
• **Dawn** (भोर): The first appearance of light in the sky before sunrise.
 
 
• **Example:** The rooster crowed at dawn.
 
 
 
• **Day break** (प्रभात): The time in the morning when daylight first appears.
 
 
• **Example:** The farmers started their work at day break.
